title: MongoBench: Do LLMs Know What a MongoDB Query Will Do?
title_zh: MongoBench：大语言模型知道 MongoDB 查询会做什么吗？

paragraphs.en: 发布 MongoBench 基准，评估模型预测 MongoDB 查询后果的能力，发现会生成查询不代表能预测其效果。 LLM agents increasingly operate databases on their own: they generate queries and run them against live data. Two checks are commonly used to judge such an agent - whether it produces a valid query, and whether it reaches the right final answer - but neither tells us whether the agent knows what its query will actually do before it runs. We argue that this consequence prediction ability must be evaluated in its own right, and we build MongoBench to measure it: given a collection of documents and a MongoDB find() filter, a model must return the exact set of matching _ids, with ground truth from a real mongod server. The 300 items each compose three or four documented matching pitfalls and are proposed symmetrically by three vendors' models, so results stratify by item source. Evaluating four models - frontier systems from three vendors and one open-weight reasoner - accuracy ranges from 70.1% to 92.1%, a 22-point spread. Each proposer mispredicts 10-31% of the items it wrote itself, so producing a query does not imply predicting its effect. A failure-mode analysis shows errors are better predicted by which semantic pitfall a query exercises - range comparisons and null - than by surface measures such as document count or the number of composed rules. Prepending a verified rule sheet helps unevenly; executing the original filter against the engine yields reliable match sets, but delegation must be checked: on 28% of items (averaged over three runs) one model's executed filters never passed a canonical check against the intended query, and it answered about 22 of them wrong, while the other three passed on every item. We release the benchmark, the mongod oracle, and the evaluation code with all prompts at https://github.com/research-repo-bai/MongoBench.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 智能体越来越多地自主操作数据库：它们生成查询并对真实数据执行。为此我们发布 MongoBench 基准，评估模型预测 MongoDB 查询后果的能力，发现会生成查询并不代表能预测其效果。 目前通常用两项检查来评判这类智能体——它是否生成了有效查询，以及是否得到了正确的最终答案——但这两者都不能说明智能体在执行之前是否知道自己的查询实际会做什么。 我们认为这种后果预测能力必须作为独立的能力加以评估，为此构建了 MongoBench 来度量它：给定一个文档集合和一个 MongoDB find() 过滤器，模型必须返回精确匹配的 _id 集合，真实答案来自真实的 mongod 服务器。 这 300 个条目每个都组合了三到四个有文档记载的匹配陷阱，并由三家厂商的模型对称地提出，因此结果可以按条目来源分层。 我们评估了四个模型——来自三家厂商的前沿系统和一个开放权重的推理模型——准确率介于 70.1% 到 92.1% 之间，相差 22 个百分点。 每个提出者对自己写的条目也有 10–31% 预测错误，因此能生成查询并不意味着能预测其效果。 失败模式分析表明，错误更能由查询考察的语义陷阱类型——范围比较和 null——来预测，而不是由文档数量或组合规则数量等表面指标来预测。 在提示前附加经过验证的规则表效果不均衡；对引擎执行原始过滤器可以得到可靠的匹配集合，但委托执行必须加以核查：在 28% 的条目上（三次运行取平均），一个模型执行的过滤器从未通过与目标查询的规范化校验，并且它对其中约 22 个条目给出了错误答案，而另外三个模型在所有条目上都通过了校验。 我们在 https://github.com/research-repo-bai/MongoBench 发布了该基准、mongod 真值服务以及包含全部提示词的评估代码。
